correctness.rationale: The finite Birkhoff ideal representation and formula for pseudocomplement are explicit. Comparability components give exactly 2^c excluded-middle solutions; minimal elements determine all negations and hence exactly 2^m fixed points. A connected poset with t minima has precisely the claimed realizable ideal-count range, demonstrated by an explicit chain atop t minima. Multiplication proves the full spectrum. A strict product lower bound gives all positive-defect endpoints and iff rigidity. The k=0 nonBoolean endpoint is separately proved. A 5,231-poset finite census corroborates but does not replace the all-size proof.

The new result specifies every attainable pair, the entire four-outcome joint law, optimal envelopes at every power-of-two discrepancy, and all equality cases.
